newsitem.title: INDIA: India copper, zinc see gains, nicket bounces back.
newsitem.headline: India copper, zinc see gains, nicket bounces back.

text.p: Indian copper and zinc extended gains on Tuasday while tin suffered a fresh setback on the metal market, dealers said.
Nickel prices bounced back from lower levels while other base metals were steady in a narrow price band.

Dealers said copper and zinc lifted further on the back of restricted arrivals and fresh physical buying following an uptrend in the world market. Copper rose by 50 rupees at 13,300 rupees per quintal while zinc rose by same margin at 7,550 rupees.
State-owned Hindustan Copper Ltd has hiked selling prices by 5,000 rupees per tonne, while Hindustan Zinc Ltd has hiked prices by 2,500 rupees per tonne for March.
Tin fell further by 400 rupees to 31,800 rupees per quintal on fresh unloading by the stockist. Tin was down by 100 rupees on Monday and was down by 2,000 rupees on Saturday.
